reason: Continue incomplete operational recovery after rate-limit rejections, correcting the v3.1 total-versus-consecutive counter and preserving source identities.
subjectPolicy: Only original HTTP429 rows never retried in v3.1; at most one retry. Never repeat any completed or unparsable subject.
monitorPolicy: Use persisted valid A/B subject responses. Skip every completed monitor response, including unparseable outputs. At most one retry after an explicit HTTP429, following a 45-second cooldown.

scheduling.stop: No automatic retry for ambiguous outcomes; halt after ten 429s, two consecutive non-429 failures, a call/cost cap, or planned completion.

priceBasis: Live endpoint catalog checked on 2026-09-13: highest advertised prompt $0.35/M and completion $0.95/M. Fixed input lengths and output caps fit the $0.005 per-call allowance with headroom. Returned usage is recorded; missing costs retain a reserve.
interpretation: Original v3 partial result remains intact. Combined recovery is separately labeled and cannot erase missingness or original operational failures.
